android.desc:
This app converts numbers into the modern and traditional Telugu numeral formats.

The modern format of Telugu numbers is the same as numbers used today except the script is changed from Latin to Telugu.

The traditional format of Telugu numbers involves a base-10 component for the integer portion of a number and a base-4 component for the fractional portion. Furthermore, a different set of digits are used to represent the fractional portion. Integers will still appear similar to the modern format but non-integers will look very different.

quotes.text:
I actually made an app a few years ago that converts to the traditional Telugu style of decimals. Its interesting how the fractions in spoken Telugu are based around 1/4ths but few people know about the same applying for the written expression as you mentioned.

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.telugu_numerals
